name: hermes-delegated-auth follows the skill
prompt: On Hermes, send mail as SCALEKIT_IDENTIFIER.

judge.check: Agent followed hermes-delegated-auth. It treated Hermes as the host and Scalekit as the vault. It did not start integrate-agentkit-host OpenClaw wiring or write app-code SDK calls.

Agent asked the human to write SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET, and SCALEKIT_IDENTIFIER into host env. It did not invent those values or copy them from another project.
Agent named tool_exec.py list-connections / generate-link / execute-tool. It did not run hermes mcp login against Scalekit. It did not mint a Virtual MCP session token for another end user.
Agent said a single-operator host may hold one operator bearer. It did not treat the Slack gateway bot as the named user.
